messages.text: My sheet is named Members. Row 1 has headers, and each row after that is one club member (rows 2 to 13). Column A is First Name, B is Last Name, C is Email, D is Dues Paid (a checkbox, so true or false), and E is Volunteer Hours (a number). Write Apps Script that logs the names of members who haven't paid their dues, and the total volunteer hours for all members.
